description: This file defines the class ProductPromoWorker, containing static methods for handling product promotion logic in an e-commerce shopping cart context, such as retrieving promotions, checking promotion codes, and applying promotions based on various rules and conditions.

classes.name: ProductPromoWorker
classes.description: Worker class for catalog/product promotion related functionality, providing static methods for retrieving, evaluating, and applying promotions within a shopping cart context.

methods.name: getStoreProductPromos
methods.description: Retrieves active store-specific product promotions applicable to the current shopping cart, considering date constraints and manual promotion settings.

methods.name: getStoreProductPromoCodes
methods.description: Extracts promotion codes from the store promotions associated with the current shopping cart, used for validation and application.

methods.name: getProductStorePromotions
methods.description: Fetches all active promotions for the product store linked to the shopping cart, considering date validity and manual promotion restrictions.

methods.name: getAgreementPromotions
methods.description: Retrieves promotions associated with a specific customer agreement relevant to the current shopping cart session.

methods.name: doPromotions
methods.description: Main entry point to process and apply promotions to the shopping cart, orchestrating retrieval and execution of promotion rules based on order type or agreement.

methods.name: hasOrderTotalCondition
methods.description: Determines if a product promotion includes a total order amount condition, influencing promotion application order.

methods.name: runProductPromos
methods.description: Executes the promotion rules on the shopping cart, iterating through promotion conditions, actions, and enforcing limits.

methods.name: getProductPromoUseLimit
methods.description: Calculates the maximum number of times a promotion can be applied, considering order, customer, and promotion-specific limits.

methods.name: getProductPromoCodeUseLimit
methods.description: Computes the remaining application limit for a promotional code based on past usage by the customer.

methods.name: checkCanUsePromoCode
methods.description: Validates if a promotion code is eligible for use, checking expiration, date range, associated store codes, and usage limits.

methods.name: makeAutoDescription
methods.description: Generates a human-readable description for a promotion, detailing conditions and actions for display purposes.

methods.name: checkCondition
methods.description: Evaluates whether a specific promotion condition is satisfied, potentially invoking custom service logic.

methods.name: checkConditionsForItem
methods.description: Checks if the conditions for a promotion rule/action are satisfied for a specific cart item.

methods.name: performAction
methods.description: Executes the specified promotion action on the shopping cart, invoking services or applying adjustments.

methods.name: performAction
methods.description: Overloaded method to execute the promotion action, updating promotion use info accordingly.

methods.name: getCartItemsUsed
methods.description: Returns list of cart items that are used in a specific promotion action.

methods.name: getCartItemsUsedTotalAmount
methods.description: Calculates the total amount of cart items used in a specific promotion.

methods.name: distributeDiscountAmount
methods.description: Distributes the total discount amount across used cart items proportional to their prices.

methods.name: findPromoItem
methods.description: Finds the index of a cart item that matches the given promotion action adjustments.

methods.name: doOrderItemPromoAction
methods.description: Creates or updates an order item adjustment for a promotion, applying the specified amount.

methods.name: doOrderPromoAction
methods.description: Creates an order-wide promotion adjustment.

methods.name: getProductPromoDescription
methods.description: Fetches a descriptive name or text for a promotion to include in adjustments.

methods.name: getPromoRuleCondProductIds
methods.description: Retrieves product IDs associated with promotion rule conditions.

methods.name: getPromoRuleActionProductIds
methods.description: Retrieves product IDs associated with promotion rule actions.

methods.name: makeProductPromoIdSet
methods.description: Generates sets of product IDs that are included or excluded based on promotional categories and products.

methods.name: makeProductPromoCondActionIdSets
methods.description: Builds sets of product IDs involved in promotion conditions and actions.

methods.name: handleProductPromoCategories
methods.description: Processes product promo categories, including subcategories and groupings, to include/exclude relevant products.

methods.name: getAllProductIds
methods.description: Adds product IDs from given categories to the set, with optional inclusion/exclusion.

methods.name: handleProductPromoProducts
methods.description: Processes specific product promos to include/exclude products directly.

methods.name: isProductOld
methods.description: Checks if a product has been discontinued based on sales discontinuation date.

methods.name: checkConditionPartyHierarchy
methods.description: Verifies party hierarchy relationships for promotion conditions.

methods.name: ActionResultInfo
methods.description: Container class for promotion action execution results, including flags and totals.

methods.name: UseLimitException
methods.description: Exception class used internally for limit management during promotion application.
